title: GNSS Time Exploitation — protocol-wide wins
description: All LICHEN nodes have GNSS. The protocol should exploit universal wall-clock time throughout, not hedge for clockless nodes. Spec changes landed in 09-packets-timing.md (GNSS assumption, degraded behavior), 06-security.md (time-bounded dedup, time-assisted replay), 05-routing.md (announce age, TTL-aware eviction), 07-transport-app.md (absolute cache deadlines), 12-apps.md (tightened timestamp/TTL semantics), 11-lci.md (cross-mesh log correlation). All three implementations need work.
